note: Private campground on Cordell Hull Lake (Cumberland River) near Granville, a former Corps of Engineers park, with a boat launch and swimming beach. The lakeshore loop's sites sit behind a band of bank trees with the water seen through them. Many sites are let to seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: Operating private campground on Cordell Hull Lake: E/W sites $50+tax (primitive $30), phone reservations, closed Dec 1-Mar 1, two bathhouses with showers, laundry, small store, dump. Riverview confirmed (continuous bank tree line between the shore pads 29-53 and the lake). Google 4.5/137. Passes the gate exactly at $50; has a sizeable seasonal program whose share could not be measured.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): cheapest RV night $50 + tax (electric and water site, operator pricing page read 2026-11-24, no seasonal variation posted); exactly at the line, passes. No online engine (phone booking). gateways.py not needed at $50. GOOGLE 4.5 from 137 reviews; RV Life 5*/$$ stored.

LONG-STAY (unmeasured): the operator runs a seasonal program (season March-October, 12-month payments, rigs may winter on site, renew by Nov 15) but caps stays at 20 days a month ('no one can live here') and prices nightly sites publicly ($50) with phone reservations and cancellation rules. No online inventory, so the nightly share cannot be counted; leaf-off Esri imagery shows roughly 30-35 rigs parked on the 53-54 sites, consistent with a large seasonal share. Five tests: (1) no wording discourages nightly guests; (2) nightly price posted; (3) Google 4.5/137 with tags for boating/swimming/cabins reads as recreational; (4) share unknown, possibly over half seasonal; (5) no lots sold. Keep; the proposed note says 'Many sites are let to seasonal campers' rather than inventing a count.

WATERFRONT: stored 'riverview' kept. The shore pads (map sites 29-53, around 36.2375,-85.7965 to 36.2395,-85.7975) sit ~20-30 m from Cordell Hull Lake but behind a continuous bank tree line on leaf-off Esri imagery; the operator's photos show the lake through willows and hardwoods ('Best view of Cordell Hull Lake in the campground' is a view claim). No site has open ground to the water -> view, not waterfront. The stored evidence's 'pads ~150 m down to a sandy beach' describes the swimming area at the south end, not the shore loop.

Stored note claims not found on the operator site and dropped from the proposed note: 'boat-in sites', '5 pull-thrus', 'max RV ~40-50 ft', '~33 elec+water (30/50A)'. hookups (electric 50, water) and sites (count 53, pull_through) stay as derived from that old prose - the operator site states only 'Electric and Water camping sites' (no amperage) and the park map numbers 54 sites.
PIN: stored 36.23763,-85.79360 vs Google 36.23783,-85.79332 (~35 m) - fine. Website and phone confirmed unchanged; operator email indiancreek.tn@gmail.com.
